scientific_integrity: Uniform mapping-cone and lens-space CW proof; finite combinatorial checks for p=3 and p=5 only; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only odd prime widths and the rotating-leaf cyclic action; no full homotopy-group computation, no composite-width or Moore-wedge assertion. A previously published equivariant ball decomposition is expressly credited.
title: Prime cyclic forest quotients of \(K_{2,p}\) as lens-space mapping cones
